task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel LSV benchmark chart, variant 04. Scenario: multi-catalyst OER with close curves.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel linear sweep voltammetry / polarization curve benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel LSV/polarization-style chart with four catalyst curves and an in-panel legend at upper left. The full figure is the target panel; all axis labels, ticks, and legend are contained inside the saved crop. No inset and no shared outer axes/legend were observed.

x.visible_pattern: Five visible x ticks from 1.3 to 1.7 are evenly spaced at roughly 195 px intervals along the bottom axis.
x.justification: Visible tick spacing is uniform, and the fit validator chose a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.0004; log10 fit was markedly worse.

y.visible_pattern: Visible y ticks run 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 with near-uniform spacing of about 143 px on the left axis.
y.justification: The fit validator chose a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.0004. A log10 mapping is incompatible with the visible zero tick.

unresolved_ambiguities: No explicit panel letter/label is printed in the image; the single visible panel was treated as the requested target panel.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: No overlap-induced hidden segments warrant a separate recovery pass; only the left tail of the blue dashed curve was conservatively shortened.

curves.overlap_notes: Black solid trace remains visually separable across the full sweep.
Blue dashed trace is clear from the mid-sweep onward; the near-zero left segment was truncated to avoid legend and low-current ambiguity.
curves.suspected_gap_notes: Left tail below about x=400 is visible but was omitted because the dashed trace sits close to the border and legend region under the QA utility.

curves.overlap_notes: Red dash-dot trace is distinct by color across the full sweep.
Green dotted trace remains separated from the other curves; the dotted style slightly lowers continuous-polyline QA overlap.

response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel LSV-style plot with four legend-mapped catalyst curves. The blue dashed curve is conservatively truncated on the left to avoid legend-adjacent and border-adjacent ambiguity under the QA utility. The green dotted curve remains visually separable across the main plot, but its dotted style scores slightly lower under continuous-polyline QA.
unresolved_ambiguities: FeNi-2 left-tail dashed segment near the lower border and legend region was omitted conservatively and is marked partial.
Ni foam remains visually distinct, but the dotted style yields a QA warn-level overlap score under continuous-polyline evaluation.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage

panels.overlap_recovery_reason: No overlap-induced hidden segments warrant a separate recovery pass; only the left tail of the blue dashed curve was conservatively shortened.
